verdict.rationale: Snyk IaC explicitly supports scanning Terraform, Kubernetes, CloudFormation, and ARM for misconfigurations, with workflows across IDE, SCM, CLI, and Terraform Cloud/Enterprise, plus drift detection for manually created resources. This directly matches the devops-lead story with strong first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration specifically of IaC scanning accuracy (community evidence pack only discusses OSS/container/appsec tools, not IaC).
